sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
turns: Yeah, so how's your lawn coming along?
It's pretty much done, actually. Just mowing and a little edging. It's a lot of work, honestly. Not that I hate it, but my back isn't what it used to be.

Yeah, I get that. My back's been killing me lately too. I'm actually the manager at the grocery store now, but I still end up doing a lot of the yard stuff because I live out in the country. I tell people all the time, "I'm a manager, I manage!" but half the time I'm out pulling weeds or fixing a fence. It's kind of ridiculous, honestly. Does it bother you that it's so much physical labor?

Yeah, it's a grind. Yeah, that's exactly why I just let nature take its course now. I'm at the store all day dealing with people's choices, so looking at my own neglected plot just gives me the willies. I'm kind of glad it's a little wild out there.
